name: Mary Magdalene
bio: Mary Magdalene followed Jesus from Galilee and ministered to him, and was among the women who watched his crucifixion from a distance and kept vigil at his tomb afterward (Matthew 27:55-61). At dawn on the first day of the week, she and the other Mary came to the tomb and were met by an angel announcing Jesus's resurrection; as they hurried away afraid yet overjoyed, Jesus himself met them, and they took hold of his feet and worshipped him (Matthew 28:1-10).
